saint_reference.note: Anselm of Canterbury (1033–1109) was a Benedictine monk, philosopher, theologian, and Archbishop of Canterbury. He is known for his work on the concept of God as 'that-than-which-no-greater-can-be-conceived', and for his role in the Gregorian Reform of the English Church.
